full_judgment: 2. The facts giving rise to the issuance of the Rule in a nutshell can be stated thus: The opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff instituted the original Other Class Suit No.1 of 1984 in the court of the learned Assistant Judge, Domar, Nilphamari for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession contending inter alia that the suit property originally belong to the predecessor of the plaintiff and defendants Nos. 13-21, Monir Uddin Chowdhury. At the demise of Monir Uddin Chowdhury there was an amicable partition among the heirs of Monir Uddin Chowdhury and by virtue of that amicable partition the plaintiff obtained the 'ka' schedule land. The further case of the plaintiff is such that the predecessor of other defendants, namely Siddique Hossen obtained lease from the father of the plaintiff during his life time and while Siddique Hossen stopped in paying the rent, the father of the plaintiff after filing a suit obtained a decree, against which Siddique Hossen ran up to the Honourable Supreme Court of Bangladesh but being failed purchased the land described in schedule 'Ga' of the plaint from other co-sharers. Monir Uddin Chowdhury and one Azizar Rahman subsequently amicably possessed their shares and by way of compromise the plaintiff, exclusively possessed the suit land and in the month of August, 1971 the predecessor of the defendants Siddique Hossen forcibly entered into the 'Ka' schedule land and creating a boundary erected homestead with the help of the then Pakistan Army who had a camp at Chilahati and Siddique Hossen was a member of the then peace committee which was formed by the occupation force Pakistan Army and out of fear at that time, the plaintiff could not give any resistance to Siddique Hossen, the predecessor of the defendants. Subsequently, after the independence of Bangladesh the plaintiff repeatedly requested the defendants to hand over vacant possession of the suit land but the defendants denied. Finding no other alternative, the plaintiff instituted the original suit for confirmation of title and eviction of the defendants from the suit property.
